kinds.name: Grid palette
kinds.description: The Grid's placement panel. A checked draft reloads in place, inside a Grid space.

kinds.name: Shoreline look
kinds.description: Foam strength and softness on the beach shoreline.

kinds.name: Grid scenery
kinds.description: Floor line spacing and backdrop wall height shared by Grid spaces.

kinds.name: Workshop action
kinds.description: A data-only action that moves, recolors or resets entities in one Grid space.

kinds.name: Behavior plugin
kinds.description: A behavior an entity runs, such as a pulse or a door link. A script plus its manifest.

kinds.name: Environment package
kinds.description: A zone's reviewed builder, spawn, bounds, lighting, water, views and capabilities.

kinds.name: Command set
kinds.description: Commands shared by MCP, F2, the palette and Godot, with their argument schemas.

kinds.name: Project source
kinds.description: Any other script, shader, data file or scene under world/. It hot loads into the running world: shaders swap, scripts reload keeping their state, and the environment rebuilds or the world restarts in place only when a change needs it.
